resolutions.verification: HM_WEEK_ANCHOR_DATE=2018-09-19 maps 2020-09-09..2020-09-15 -> week 103 (7 days, Dev Week) and 2020-09-16..2020-09-22 -> week 104 (7 days, Final Test Week). Covered by test_a01_shared_week_calendar_and_leakage_guard.

prepare_lgbm_query_frame() sorts and groups by (target_week, customer_idx) and enforces unique (target_week, customer_idx, article_id). Multi-week customer probe returns groups=[2, 2]. Covered by test_a02_lgbm_query_grouping_by_week_and_customer.

resolve_bronze_output_dir() and resolve_silver_output_dir() route --smoke-test to data/lakehouse_smoke/... and raise ValueError if smoke output equals production paths; B0 checks pre-lpad digit regex; B1 adds mapping_version to customer_mapping. Covered by test_a03_smoke_test_output_isolation.

resolve_detector_class_from_model_names() rejects unadapted COCO80 checkpoints (0='person') and maps Fashionpedia-12 / YOLO-World class names cleanly; FashionDetector passes device=self.device. Covered by test_a04_detector_ontology_guard_rejects_coco80.

UserTower handles all-zero history via safe key_padding_mask and learned empty_history_emb fallback (0 NaN across 64 dims) and applies positional + recency time-decay weighting. Covered by test_a05_and_a19_two_tower_empty_history_time_decay_and_oov.

UserInteractionEvent and VisualSearchPayload enforce UUID event_id, ISO-8601 timezone-aware timestamps, finite non-negative price, valid literal enums, customer_id validation, and 7-digit product_code prefix consistency. Covered by test_invalid_contracts_raise.
Added KAFKA_LOG_DIRS: /var/lib/kafka/data matching mounted volume kafka_data:/var/lib/kafka/data; verified with docker compose config --quiet.
EventSimulator and S1 stream processor emit/parse UTC event_time as streaming watermark clock while preserving historical H&M date in original_t_dat.

Added record_session_event_idempotent() using event:seen:{event_id} deduplication and publish_trending_window_snapshot() for atomic window snapshot replacement. Covered by test_a09_a16_a17_a18_and_kappa_edge_cases.
Formalized Two-Stage Temporal Split: Dev Week = 103 (2020-09-09..15) for tuning/ablation/gate calibration, Final Test Week = 104 (2020-09-16..22) for final holdout evaluation.
Added i2i_precision_at_k() excluding query_article_id, documented pre-filter vs post-filter CatConsistency@10, and specified frozen qrels + shared Ideal DCG over pooled union.

Synchronized table names (silver/articles_enriched, gold/candidates_b6, gold/features_b7), Redis keys/TTLs (session:* TTL 1800s, trending:1h:top100 TTL 3600s), API routes (/recommend/{customer_id}), and Qdrant hm_visual_search vectors (image_dense 768-d, tt_item_dense 64-d).
Chunked NumPy fallback in compute_user_item_visual_similarity() by batch_size to avoid peak RAM spikes; labeled INFRA tables as Design Budgets & Target SLAs until measured.
Added [tool.setuptools.packages.find] where=['.'] include=['src*', 'spark_jobs*'] to pyproject.toml and documented --system-site-packages venv setup.
check_hm256_aspect_ratio.py compares 256x256 images against original H&M images when available and returns INCONCLUSIVE_NO_ORIGINAL_REFERENCE when originals are absent.
validate_existing_collection_params() verifies existing Qdrant collection vector dimensions before indexing. Covered by test_a09_a16_a17_a18_and_kappa_edge_cases.
get_text_tokenizer_kwargs() sets padding='max_length' and max_length=64 for SigLIP/FashionSigLIP models. Covered by test_a09_a16_a17_a18_and_kappa_edge_cases.

map_at_k() and candidate_recall_at_k() materialize ground_truth iterables once into sets so single-pass generators yield identical metrics to lists/sets. Covered by test_a09_a16_a17_a18_and_kappa_edge_cases.
Added recency time-decay weighting to UserTower and OOV/ID-dropout support to ItemTower for cold-start item generalization. Covered by test_a05_and_a19_two_tower_empty_history_time_decay_and_oov.
/health reports status='scaffold_only' with dependencies_checked=False, and /events sets persisted=False until TASK-SRV-01 wires live dependencies.
